_comment: Hand-reviewed structured reading of context_notes.csv. 'summary' is our own paraphrase. 'effect' is raises_cost only if the raw note says costs went UP; notes saying costs were unaffected / conditions normal are 'none'. Validated against the raw CSV at load time (id, date, scope).

notes.summary: flooding on the Chennai-Bangalore highway forced detours and raised trip costs from 24 Feb to 8 Mar 2025
notes.basis: window stated explicitly in the note text

notes.summary: a regional festival week led transporters to add a temporary surcharge on the Ahmedabad-Mumbai corridor
notes.basis: ASSUMPTION: note gives only a start date and says 'festival week'; treated as the 7 days from the note date

notes.summary: nationwide diesel prices rose from the week of 5 May 2025, lifting costs on all routes by roughly 5-7%
notes.basis: no end date in the note; config.OPEN_ENDED_WINDOW_WEEKS applies. Magnitude cap 7% (+ tolerance)

notes.summary: a new toll plaza opened, but on stretches that are not part of this dataset
notes.basis: note itself says affected routes are outside the dataset

notes.summary: highway maintenance on Mumbai-Delhi caused minor delays for about a week, with costs not significantly affected
notes.basis: note says costs not significantly affected

notes.summary: an industry report found freight capacity demand stable this quarter with no major disruptions
notes.basis: describes stability, not a cost driver

notes.summary: road conditions on the Delhi-Jaipur stretch improved after resurfacing
notes.basis: an improvement, not a cost-raising event

notes.summary: no significant disruptions on the Kolkata-Bhubaneswar corridor; freight movement normal
the Chennai-Bangalore route returned to normal conditions after flood repairs were completed
notes.basis: marks the END of the disruption, not a cost driver

notes.summary: a vehicle tracking mandate for commercial fleets was introduced, with compliance costs absorbed by transporters and no rate change
